result: Built a fresh 8 GiB Pi 4B raw-image candidate with the current Pi desktop payload, firmware FAT32 boot partition, full-size RedSea data region, and two source banks. The psdopen message now accurately says writes flush before returning. The image has not been flashed to or tested from a physical microSD card.

zealos_data.contents: Full-size RedSea volume followed by two 32 MiB append-only source banks

checks: The image builder verified MBR extents, FAT32 boot-sector structure, required firmware and payload file read-back, RedSea geometry/root/Home/Tmp/bitmap, and both source-bank headers.
scripts/check-pi-desktop-image.py passed native/recovery ELF, relocation, boot-chain, and source-module checks.
make check-pi4-platform passed, including MBR/GPT validation, partition-bounded I/O with FAT isolation, and fake SDHCI single-block reads/writes/flush/read-back.
known_scope: This is a host-built raw image, not a Pi USB-CD installer or UTM ISO.
The Pi guest must explicitly run psdopen before writes; the binding is not restored automatically after reboot.
Physical SD-controller write, card read-back, and cold-boot persistence remain unverified.
Directory deletion, rename, automatic directory growth, and general writable USB storage are not included.
